blocks.orig: Board a semi-submarine on a late afternoon and admire the stunning fire sky during the sunset around the beautiful Bawe Island, in the middle of the Indian Ocean on the west of Zanzibar’s capital Stone Town. Once it’s dark, you can experience an immersive trip to observe the seabed illuminated by the ship’s LED lights. A semi-submarine vessel stays afloat but has space below the waterline featuring underwater windows that allow you to explore the reef from the comfort of your seat!
blocks.html: Step aboard a semi-submarine in the late afternoon and watch the sky turn to fire at sunset around lovely Bawe Island, out in the Indian Ocean west of Stone Town, the capital of Zanzibar. When darkness falls, you set off on an immersive trip to see the seabed lit up by the vessel’s LED lights. A semi-submarine floats on the surface but has a space below the waterline with underwater windows, so you can explore the reef without leaving your seat!
